entries.task_id: wiadze yi|mu|fahodzi
entries.description: wiadze yi mu fahodzi
entries.subject: wiadze yi

spans.text: Ɔnam dɛ adasa hɔn enyimnyam yɛ pɛr na ndzinoa a obi nngye mmfi hɔn nsamu a wɔwɔ no ngyetomu nye wiadze yi mu fahodzi, pɛrpɛrdzi, ntsɛntsenenee na asomdwee ne fapem;

entries.task_id: a no|mu|nyimpa benya fahodzi wɔ kasa
entries.description: a no mu nyimpa benya fahodzi wɔ kasa
entries.subject: a no

spans.text: Ɔnam dɛ tsia a yetsiatsia nyimpa ne ndzinoa do no dze ewurkadze nwenwen a obiara tsia aba, na afei so wɔabɔ wiadze a ɔreba a no mu nyimpa benya fahodzi wɔ kasa, gyedzi, suro na ohia ho dawur dɛ nyimpapem nyina hɔn ahwehwɛdze tsitsir,

entries.task_id: nkabɔmu kuw|mu|nyimpa nyina edua farbaa nwoma no do agye hɔn gyedzi a ɔwɔ adasa awose ndzinoa
entries.description: Nkabɔmu Kuw mu nyimpa nyina edua Farbaa Nwoma no do agye hɔn gyedzi a ɔwɔ adasa awose ndzinoa
entries.subject: Nkabɔmu Kuw
entries.object: nyimpa nyina edua Farbaa Nwoma no do agye hɔn gyedzi a ɔwɔ adasa awose ndzinoa

spans.text: Ɔnam dɛ Amanaman Nkabɔmu Kuw mu nyimpa nyina edua Farbaa Nwoma no do agye hɔn gyedzi a ɔwɔ adasa awose ndzinoa, nyimpa n'enyimnyam na nyimpa no bo a ɔsom, na mbanyin na mbaa hɔn ndzinoa a ɔyɛ pɛr ato mu na wɔabɔ hɔn enyim biriw dɛ wobotu asetsena mu kankɔ na atseyie mpon,

entries.task_id: pɛr ato|mu|na wɔabɔ hɔn enyim biriw dɛ wobotu asetsena mu kankɔ na atseyie mpon
entries.description: pɛr ato mu na wɔabɔ hɔn enyim biriw dɛ wobotu asetsena mu kankɔ na atseyie mpon
entries.subject: pɛr ato
entries.object: na wɔabɔ hɔn enyim biriw dɛ wobotu asetsena mu kankɔ na atseyie mpon

spans.text: Ɔnam dɛ Amanaman Nkabɔmu Kuw mu nyimpa nyina edua Farbaa Nwoma no do agye hɔn gyedzi a ɔwɔ adasa awose ndzinoa, nyimpa n'enyimnyam na nyimpa no bo a ɔsom, na mbanyin na mbaa hɔn ndzinoa a ɔyɛ pɛr ato mu na wɔabɔ hɔn enyim biriw dɛ wobotu asetsena mu kankɔ na atseyie mpon,

NHYIAMU KƐSE NO YI ADASA NDZINOA HO DAWURBƆ no kyerɛ dɛ: ɔno nye nhwhɛdodze tsitsir a ɔwɔ hɔ ma nyimpa na aman nyina, ama ankorankor biara na nyimpa kuw biara, sɛ wɔdze dɛm dawurbɔ yi si hɔn enyim a, wɔaabɔ mbɔdzen edua nkyerɛ na adzesua do ama nkorɔfo eedzi ndzinoa na fahoazi ahorow no nyi; na wɔaatɔa do afa hɔnara hɔn man na amanaman nhyehyɛɛ do wɔama wɔaagye dawurbɔ yi ato mu na woeedzi do wɔ Aman a wɔdɔm Nkabɔmu Kuw no mu biara mu nye asaase biara a wɔhyɛ hɔn ase no so do.

entries.task_id: hɔn nkitahodzi|mu|ndzeyɛɛ da no edzi dɛ wɔyɛ enuanom
entries.description: hɔn nkitahodzi mu ndzeyɛɛ da no edzi dɛ wɔyɛ enuanom
entries.subject: hɔn nkitahodzi
entries.object: ndzeyɛɛ da no edzi dɛ wɔyɛ enuanom

spans.text: Wɔmaa hɔn nyina adwen na tsibowa, na ɔwɔ dɛ hɔn nkitahodzi mu ndzeyɛɛ da no edzi dɛ wɔyɛ enuanom.

entries.task_id: dawurbɔ yi|mu|no ho kwan a nyiyimu biara nnyi mu a ɔfa no obi n'awosu anaa no honamenyi ngyegyee mbrɛ ɔtse
entries.description: Dawurbɔ yi mu no ho kwan a nyiyimu biara nnyi mu a ɔfa no obi n'awosu anaa no honamenyi ngyegyee mbrɛ ɔtse
entries.subject: Dawurbɔ yi
entries.object: no ho kwan a nyiyimu biara nnyi mu a ɔfa no obi n'awosu anaa no honamenyi ngyegyee mbrɛ ɔtse

spans.text: Obiara wɔ ndizona na fahodzi a wɔada no edzi wɔ Dawurbɔ yi mu no ho kwan a nyiyimu biara nnyi mu a ɔfa no obi n'awosu anaa no honamenyi ngyegyee mbrɛ ɔtse, dɛ ɔyɛ banyin anaa ɔyɛ basia, ne kasaa a ɔkã, ne nyamesom mbrɛ ɔtse, amanyɛ ho adwen a ɔwɔ, ne man anaa asetsena mu gyinabew a ofi mu, egyapadze a ɔwɔ, n'awofo hɔn gyinabew anaa gyinabew fofor biara so a ɔwɔ ho.
Obiara wɔ ho kwan dɛ mbra no bɔ no ho ban tsia nyiyimu a obu Dawurbɔ yi mu nsɛmpɔw no mu biara do no, nye nunu biara a wonunu nyimpa ma ɔyɛ ma ɔyɛ nyiyimu no.

entries.task_id: anaa asetsena|mu|gyinabew a ofi mu
entries.description: anaa asetsena mu gyinabew a ofi mu
entries.subject: anaa asetsena

spans.text: Obiara wɔ ndizona na fahodzi a wɔada no edzi wɔ Dawurbɔ yi mu no ho kwan a nyiyimu biara nnyi mu a ɔfa no obi n'awosu anaa no honamenyi ngyegyee mbrɛ ɔtse, dɛ ɔyɛ banyin anaa ɔyɛ basia, ne kasaa a ɔkã, ne nyamesom mbrɛ ɔtse, amanyɛ ho adwen a ɔwɔ, ne man anaa asetsena mu gyinabew a ofi mu, egyapadze a ɔwɔ, n'awofo hɔn gyinabew anaa gyinabew fofor biara so a ɔwɔ ho.

entries.description: obi fi mu no n'amanyɛ kwan
entries.subject: obi fi

spans.text: Bio, onnyi dɛ wogyina ɔman a obi fi mu no n'amanyɛ kwan, ne mbra anaa n'amanandze gyinabew do-dɛ ɔman no dzi ne mansin, dɛ ɔhyɛ ɔman bi no nhwɛdo ase, anaadɛ onnyi fahodzi, yɛ nyiyimu tsia nyimpa no.

entries.task_id: to nkowaasom|mu|anaadɛ wɔma ɔsom ɔsomhun
entries.description: to nkowaasom mu anaadɛ wɔma ɔsom ɔsomhun
entries.subject: to nkowaasom

spans.text: Onnyi dɛ wɔdze obiara to nkowaasom mu anaadɛ wɔma ɔsom ɔsomhun; ɔwɔ dɛ wogu nkowaasom na ndɔnkɔgua korakora.

entries.task_id: hwehwɛ n'asɛm|mu|pefee wɔ ne ndzinoa
entries.description: hwehwɛ n'asɛm mu pefee wɔ ne ndzinoa
entries.subject: hwehwɛ n'asɛm

spans.text: Obiara wɔ ho kwan dɛ bagua asɛndzifo a wɔnntɔn hɔn asowa nndzi tsena hwehwɛ n'asɛm mu pefee wɔ ne ndzinoa, n'asadze anaa ewudzisɛm ho sombo bi a wɔdze abɔ no ho.

entries.task_id: ɔman biara|mu|(noara ne man kã ho) na ɔsan ba ne man mu bio
entries.description: ɔman biara mu (noara ne man kã ho) na ɔsan ba ne man mu bio
entries.subject: ɔman biara
entries.object: (noara ne man kã ho) na ɔsan ba ne man mu bio

spans.text: Ɔyɛ obiara ne ndzinoa dɛ ofi ɔman biara mu (noara ne man kã ho) na ɔsan ba ne man mu bio.

entries.object: nye awar no ngui no mu so

spans.text: Mbanyin na mbaa nyina hɔn ndzinoa a wɔwɔ no awar ho no yɛ pɛr wɔ awar ber no mu nye awar no ngui no mu so.

entries.task_id: mba bɔ|mu|kor dɛ abɔasee kuw a nyimpa kuw biara ne farbaa fi mu wɔ adasa mu
entries.description: mba bɔ mu kor dɛ abɔasee kuw a nyimpa kuw biara ne farbaa fi mu wɔ adasa mu
entries.subject: mba bɔ
entries.object: kor dɛ abɔasee kuw a nyimpa kuw biara ne farbaa fi mu wɔ adasa mu

spans.text: Okun, ɔyer na mba bɔ mu kor dɛ abɔasee kuw a nyimpa kuw biara ne farbaa fi mu wɔ adasa mu, na ɔyɛ hɔn ndzinoa dɛ nyimpakuw no na ɔman no bɔ hɔn ho ban.

entries.subject: bi bɔ

spans.text: Obiara wɔ ndzinoa dɛ onya egyapadze a ɔyɛ no nko nedze, anaadɛ ɔnye nkorɔfo bi bɔ mu nya dɛm egyapadze no.

entries.task_id: wɔ bagua|mu|anaa nsumaa mu
entries.description: wɔ bagua mu anaa nsumaa mu
entries.subject: wɔ bagua

spans.text: Dɛm ndzinoa yi ne fã bi nye kwan a obiara wɔ dɛ ɔsesa ne nyamesom anaa ne gyedzi na kwan so a ɔfa do dze ma ne gyedzi no da edzi wɔ bagua mu anaa nsumaa mu, dɛ ɔno nko anaadɛ nyimpa binom kã ho wɔ iyi mu.

spans.text: ɔyɛ ne ndzinoa dɛ ɔfa edwuma a ɔpɛ dɛ ɔyɛ, na ɔyɛ ne ndzinoa dɛ wɔma no edwumayɛ mu nhyehyɛɛ pa, na wɔbɔ noho ban fi fietsena ho.

folded.id: obi fi|mu|no n'amanyɛ kwan
folded.subject: obi fi

spans.text: Bio, onnyi dɛ wogyina ɔman a obi fi mu no n'amanyɛ kwan, ne mbra anaa n'amanandze gyinabew do-dɛ ɔman no dzi ne mansin, dɛ ɔhyɛ ɔman bi no nhwɛdo ase, anaadɛ onnyi fahodzi, yɛ nyiyimu tsia nyimpa no.

folded.id: ɔman biara|mu|(noara ne man kã ho) na ɔsan ba ne man mu bio
folded.subject: ɔman biara
folded.object: (noara ne man kã ho) na ɔsan ba ne man mu bio

spans.text: Ɔyɛ obiara ne ndzinoa dɛ ofi ɔman biara mu (noara ne man kã ho) na ɔsan ba ne man mu bio.

folded.id: paa|mu|kã dɛ:
folded.subject: Paa

spans.text: Paa mu kã dɛ:

folded.id: pɛr ato|mu|na wɔabɔ hɔn enyim biriw dɛ wobotu asetsena mu kankɔ na atseyie mpon
folded.subject: pɛr ato
folded.object: na wɔabɔ hɔn enyim biriw dɛ wobotu asetsena mu kankɔ na atseyie mpon

spans.text: Ɔnam dɛ Amanaman Nkabɔmu Kuw mu nyimpa nyina edua Farbaa Nwoma no do agye hɔn gyedzi a ɔwɔ adasa awose ndzinoa, nyimpa n'enyimnyam na nyimpa no bo a ɔsom, na mbanyin na mbaa hɔn ndzinoa a ɔyɛ pɛr ato mu na wɔabɔ hɔn enyim biriw dɛ wobotu asetsena mu kankɔ na atseyie mpon,

NHYIAMU KƐSE NO YI ADASA NDZINOA HO DAWURBƆ no kyerɛ dɛ: ɔno nye nhwhɛdodze tsitsir a ɔwɔ hɔ ma nyimpa na aman nyina, ama ankorankor biara na nyimpa kuw biara, sɛ wɔdze dɛm dawurbɔ yi si hɔn enyim a, wɔaabɔ mbɔdzen edua nkyerɛ na adzesua do ama nkorɔfo eedzi ndzinoa na fahoazi ahorow no nyi; na wɔaatɔa do afa hɔnara hɔn man na amanaman nhyehyɛɛ do wɔama wɔaagye dawurbɔ yi ato mu na woeedzi do wɔ Aman a wɔdɔm Nkabɔmu Kuw no mu biara mu nye asaase biara a wɔhyɛ hɔn ase no so do.

folded.id: to nkowaasom|mu|anaadɛ wɔma ɔsom ɔsomhun
folded.subject: to nkowaasom

spans.text: Onnyi dɛ wɔdze obiara to nkowaasom mu anaadɛ wɔma ɔsom ɔsomhun; ɔwɔ dɛ wogu nkowaasom na ndɔnkɔgua korakora.

folded.id: wiadze yi|mu|fahodzi
folded.subject: wiadze yi

spans.text: Ɔnam dɛ adasa hɔn enyimnyam yɛ pɛr na ndzinoa a obi nngye mmfi hɔn nsamu a wɔwɔ no ngyetomu nye wiadze yi mu fahodzi, pɛrpɛrdzi, ntsɛntsenenee na asomdwee ne fapem;

folded.id: wɔ bagua|mu|anaa nsumaa mu
folded.subject: wɔ bagua

spans.text: Dɛm ndzinoa yi ne fã bi nye kwan a obiara wɔ dɛ ɔsesa ne nyamesom anaa ne gyedzi na kwan so a ɔfa do dze ma ne gyedzi no da edzi wɔ bagua mu anaa nsumaa mu, dɛ ɔno nko anaadɛ nyimpa binom kã ho wɔ iyi mu.

folded.id: wɔ nsumaa|mu|a nhyɛ biara nnyi mu
folded.subject: wɔ nsumaa

spans.text: Dɛm pɛ yi wɔnam ambatow a no mu da hɔ a wɔtow no ne ber ano do da no edzi, akorɔfo a wɔasõ ambatow no wɔ dɛ wɔma wɔtow amba wɔ nsumaa mu a nhyɛ biara nnyi mu.

folded.id: wɔdze asetsena|mu|nhyehyɛɛ ho ekyigyina bi foa akatua no do
folded.subject: wɔdze asetsena
folded.object: nhyehyɛɛ ho ekyigyina bi foa akatua no do

spans.text: Obiara a ɔyɛ edwuma no wɔ ndzinoa dɛ onya akatua a ɔsɛ na ɔtsen a ɔbɛma ɔnye n'ebusuafo enya asetsena a ɔfata nyimpa n'enyimnyam, na sɛ ohia mpo a, ɔwɔ dɛ wɔdze asetsena mu nhyehyɛɛ ho ekyigyina bi foa akatua no do.
